user.title: Username
user.description: The username to connect to OpenSearch.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password to connect to OpenSearch.

enableSSL.title: Enable SSL
enableSSL.description: Specifies to connect by using SSL.

hostAddresses.title: Host Addresses
hostAddresses.description: A comma-separated list of remote transport addresses in `ip:port format`.

clusterName.title: OpenSearch Cluster Name
clusterName.description: The name of the OpenSearch cluster.

indexName.title: Index in OpenSearch
indexName.description: The name of the OpenSearch index.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.description: The Certificate for accessing the OpenSearch cluster. You must encode this value in base64.
